title: Persistence meets resistance
literal_meaning: Tough iron meets a persistent smith.
explanation: The same word changes force across the line: the iron resists, while the smith refuses to give up. The dictionary explicitly marks these two senses. The image suggests meeting a difficult task with sustained effort rather than expecting it to yield immediately. It need not turn persistence into an obligation to continue every losing effort.
meaning_odia: ଲୁହା ସହଜରେ ବଙ୍କେ ନାହିଁ, କମାର ମଧ୍ୟ ସହଜରେ ହାର ମାନେ ନାହିଁ। ଏକା କୋଚଟ ଶବ୍ଦ ଲୁହାର ଦୃଢ଼ତା ଓ କାରିଗରର ନଛୋଡ଼ ଚେଷ୍ଟାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ୁଛି। କାମ କଠିନ ହେଲେ ଧୈର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଓ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଚେଷ୍ଟା ଦରକାର ବୋଲି ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରରୁ ବୁଝିହୁଏ।
